title: Sydney Banker Accused of Attempted Murder in France
summary: A banker from Sydney has been charged with the attempted murder of his partner. The alleged incident occurred in a luxury hotel in France. The Sydney Morning Herald and The Age reported on the charge.
summary_points: A Sydney banker faces an attempted murder charge.
The alleged victim is the banker's partner.
The incident took place in a luxury hotel in France.
The Sydney Morning Herald and The Age covered the story.
